name: ground-infantry
notes: Infantry of both armies (I-blocks, 32 x 24 cells, three authored headings mirrored): Ground Fleet rifle and rocket troopers seen from behind, and the Undercroft Host infantry side-on (Rubblings, Ashlar Guard, Corbel Brutes, Knell-bearers, Prior). Replaces the rows planned for ground-troops.json (gargoyle-ground-army 2.4); ground-troops.png keeps its rows for the v4 painter until the runtime switches. Palettes and materials come from ground-fleet.json and ground-host.json; the Host stone follows the sector. Every value is an input to tools/ground_blocks (Go).
style_prompt: pixel art, 16-bit arcade game sprite, single full body figure, crisp square pixels, limited palette, original artwork, centered, isolated, plain flat background, night lighting
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, logo, signature, ui, frame, border, blurry, photo, photorealistic, smooth gradient, multiple views, character sheet, grid, sky, horizon, ground, landscape, scenery, crowd, blood, gore, wounds, insect, chitin, tentacles, slime, real military insignia, religious symbol

heading_phrases.045: seen from behind and to the side
heading_phrases.090: seen from the side facing right

units.name: Rifle trooper
units.subject: a soldier in a light exoskeleton frame seen from behind, squared helmet with a visor strip, flat shoulder plates, battery backpack, long straight rifle

units.name: Rocket trooper
units.subject: the same soldier carrying a box shaped rocket launcher on the shoulder

units.name: Rubbling
units.subject: a tiny hunched gargoyle imp made of rough rubble stone, oversized curled ram horns, no helmet, stubby folded bat-wing nubs, holding a stone chisel spear low, glowing ember eyes

units.name: Ashlar Guard
units.subject: a cartoon gargoyle demon soldier marching, stone hide, curled horns through a dented iron helmet, glowing ember eyes, webbing and an armour vest, folded bat wings, a long spout-mouthed musket

units.name: Corbel Brute
units.subject: a stocky gargoyle demon brute with a stone yoke on its shoulders like a corbel bracket, ram horns, a launcher tube ending in a squat carved face

units.name: Knell-bearer
units.subject: a tall hooded gargoyle bell-ringer, dark cloth hood over stone face, wooden yoke across the shoulders with a heavy iron bell hanging at one end, thin gold rim on the bell, glowing ember eyes

units.name: Prior
units.subject: a gargoyle officer in a long iron-banded coat, crown of three small gilded stone pinnacles between curled horns, a tall banner pole rising from its back with a tattered bat-wing membrane pennant and a gilded pinnacle tip, holding a staff with a lantern mouth
